# Client Progress and Service Record — Gordon Castillo
Clearwater Home Support | Visit date: 04/18/2026 | Aide: Wendy Gallagher

## Visit details
Client: Gordon Castillo | Address: 418 Pine Street, Dayton, OH 45402
Visit: 9:00 AM–11:00 AM | Supervisor: Lucas Ramos

## Services performed
- Assisted with morning dressing and grooming; client completed most tasks with verbal prompts.
- Prepared oatmeal and tea. Client ate about 75% of the oatmeal and drank 8 oz of tea.
- Walked with client from bedroom to kitchen using his walker; one-person standby assistance provided.
- Changed bed linens and cleared the kitchen table.

## Client observations
At 10:20 AM, Gordon said his right arm suddenly felt weak. Wendy observed that he had difficulty lifting that arm to reach his cup. He remained alert and spoke clearly. No fall occurred during the visit. Wendy called 911 at 10:22 AM. EMS arrived at 10:34 AM and transported Gordon for evaluation.

## Progress and follow-up
Client was cooperative with personal care and ate most of breakfast. Based on the recorded intake, hydration was adequate for the visit. EMS took over care following their assessment. Follow-up with the client will be arranged after the emergency evaluation.

## Communication and disposition
Client left home with EMS at 10:46 AM. Wendy entered the visit notes in the Clearwater Home Support record at 11:12 AM. Wendy did not document notifying Lucas Ramos. The record includes the EMS response and transport times, and the services completed before the emergency were logged above.
